payments.text:

and 2030, the transaction value will rise by 390.71 billion U.S. dollars, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more

forecast_revenue.text:
Description: The revenue in the e-commerce market in Indonesia was modeled to stand at 47.99 billion U.S. dollars in 2024. Between 2017 and 2024, the revenue rose by 40.94 billion U.S. dollars, though the increase followed an uneven trajectory rather than a
consistent upward trend. The revenue will steadily rise by 28.69 billion U.S. dollars over the period from 2024 to 2029, reflecting a clear upward trend. Read more
Note(s): 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
